description: Data on results from the National Travel Attitudes Study, produced by Department for Transport.

attachments.title: Attitudes around walking and cycling
"It is important drivers leave enough space for cyclists"
Attitudes around road journeys and the environment
"I am willing to reduce the amount I travel by car, to help reduce the impact of climate change"
"I am willing to reduce the amount I travel by plane, to help reduce the impact of climate change"
View on climate change
"Many of the journeys of less than two miles that I now make by car I could just as easily walk"
"Many of the journeys of less than two miles that I now make by car I could just as easily make by bus"
"Many of the journeys of less than two miles that I now make by car I could just as easily cycle, if I had a bike"
"Which of the following has the most overall impact on climate change?"
Attitudes around aviation and climate change
"People should be able to travel by plane as much as they like, even if new terminals or runways are needed to meet the demand"
"People should be able to travel by plane as much as they like, even if this harms the environment"
"The price of a plane ticket should reflect the environmental damage that flying causes, even if this makes air travel much more expensive"
Attitudes around road congestion
"Thinking about traffic and transport problems, how serious a problem for you is congestion on motorways?"
"Thinking about traffic and transport problems, how serious a problem for you is traffic congestion in towns and cities?"
"Thinking about traffic and transport problems, how serious a problem for you is exhaust fumes from traffic in towns and cities?"
"How concerned, if at all, are you about damage to the countryside from building roads?"
"For the sake of the environment, everyone should reduce how much they use their cars"
"People should be allowed to use their cars as much as they like, even if it causes damage to the environment"
"There is no point in reducing my car use to help the environment unless others do the same"
"People who drive vehicles that are better for the environment should pay less tax than those who drive more polluting vehicles"
"Next time you buy a car, how likely would you be to buy an ultra-low emission car (either a plug-in hybrid or a battery electric car)?"
Attitudes around road safety
"Speed cameras save lives"
"Speed cameras are mostly there to make money"
"Average speed cameras are preferable to fixed speed cameras"
"It is perfectly safe to talk on a hand-held mobile phone while driving"
All mobiles while driving, including hands-free, is dangerous
"The law on using mobile phones whilst driving is not properly enforced"
"I know how much alcohol I can drink before being over the legal drink-drive limit"
"It is not safe to travel even slightly over the speed limit on motorways"
"It is not safe to travel even slightly over the speed limit on residential streets"
"On single carriageway A-roads it would be unsafe to drive at the maximum speed (i.e. 60 mph)"
"It is not important to wear a seat belt for journeys under 15 minutes, either as a passenger or when driving"
"I know how to ensure a child under the age of 7 is correctly and safely restrained in a car, i.e. that the car seat is correctly fitted and that their seat belt is fastened correctly"
"How safe, if at all, do you think it is to send a text message whilst driving on a mobile phone using your hands?"
"How safe, if at all, do you think it is to use an application (app) whilst driving on a mobile phone using your hands?"
"How safe, if at all, do you think it is to use a mobile phone whilst stationary in traffic as the driver?"
Attitudes around personal transport, public transport and the local area
"To what extent are you in favour of having speed limits of 20 miles per hour in residential streets?"
"To what extent are you in favour of having speed bumps to slow down traffic in residential streets?"
"Thinking about the last 5 years, which of the following statements best reflect your opinion of the condition of roads in your local area?"
Attitudes around disability and transport
"To what extent do you agree or disagree that there should be special provision made on public transport to accommodate disabled people?"
"How likely, if at all, would you be to make room on public transport for a disabled person?"
Harmonised questions
Coronavirus (COVID-19)
